answer_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(sl.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
WHERE
  sl.sale_country_code = (
    SELECT
      c.country_code
    FROM contoso_served.dim_country AS c
    WHERE
      c.country_name = 'Germany'
  )
